data.exact_reserve_text: In 2020, there has been an overall surplus of GBP 5.9m on prior year reserves (2019: deficit GBP 1.8m).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 7.305 million for underwriting years 2014-2018, calculated from the gross claims development triangle. This contrasts with a reported net surplus of GBP 5.9 million on prior year reserves. The strengthening reflects ongoing re-estimation of older claims, particularly in US Casualty, where the industry continues to see deterioration due to inflation of claims values, social inflation, and regulatory changes. General natural catastrophe loss activity was also a theme impacting the industry.

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development amount of GBP 7.305m is derived from the gross claims development triangle. This is a gross strengthening. The narrative text, however, states 'an overall surplus of GBP 5.9m on prior year reserves', which is a net release. The gross figure from the triangle is used as per instructions, with a note on the discrepancy with the net narrative.
